sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Blastify 2, the core gameplay mechanic is based on tapping on the same color blocks to crush them and earn points. The game features a grid-based system, where blocks of different colors are arranged in a 5x5 grid. The player's goal is to tap on the same color blocks to create a chain reaction and clear the grid. The longer the chain, the more points you earn.

The game also features a variety of game modes, including timed and untimed modes, as well as levels with specific objectives, such as collecting a certain number of targets. The game's boosters and power-ups can be used to enhance your gameplay experience, making it easier to clear the grid and achieve your goals.

Blastify 2 also features a unique feature called 'Combo Meter', which rewards players for creating long chains of blocks. The Combo Meter fills up as you create longer chains, and when it's full, you can activate a powerful combo that clears a large section of the grid. This feature adds an extra layer of depth to the gameplay, making it more challenging and exciting.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics in Blastify 2 are engaging, addictive, and easy to learn, making it a great game for players of all ages and skill levels.
